extra_vocab.en: a unit for measuring liquids, about 3.8 liters in the US
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於加油、油漆、飲料採購和成本計算的情境。美制一加侖約 3.8 公升，常和價格或油耗一起出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 兩加侖以上要用複數：two gallons；當形容詞放在名詞前要用單數加連字號：a five-gallon bucket。

example.en: The truck uses about ten gallons of fuel every day.
example.zh: 這輛卡車每天大約用十加侖的燃料。

example.en: We need a gallon of white paint for the lobby.
example.zh: 我們需要一加侖白色油漆來粉刷大廳。

example.en: Fuel prices rose to four dollars per gallon this month.
example.zh: 這個月油價漲到每加侖四美元。

example.en: The new van gets thirty miles per gallon on highways.
example.zh: 這輛新廂型車在高速公路上每加侖可跑三十英里。

examples.en: The cafe buys five gallons of fresh milk every morning.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡店每天早上買五加侖的鮮奶。

examples.en: Gas costs about four dollars a gallon at this station.
examples.zh: 這個加油站的汽油大約一加侖四美元。

examples.en: One gallon of paint covers about four hundred square feet.
examples.zh: 一加侖油漆大約可以塗四百平方英尺。

confusable.diff: 拼法開頭很像，但 gallery 是「美術館、畫廊」，不是容量單位。

example.en: The gallery will open a new art show on Friday.
example.zh: 這間畫廊週五會開一個新的藝術展。

similar.diff: liter（公升）是公制單位，一加侖約等於 3.8 公升；多數國家用 liter，美國常用 gallon。

example.en: The bottle holds one liter of cooking oil.
example.zh: 這個瓶子裝有一公升的食用油。

example.en: Please order ten liters of cleaning liquid for the office.
example.zh: 請為辦公室訂十公升的清潔液。

example.en: The price of oil rose by two dollars a barrel.
example.zh: 油價每桶上漲了兩美元。

example.en: Each bottle contains sixteen ounces of orange juice.
example.zh: 每瓶含有十六盎司的柳橙汁。

extra_vocab.en: a building where you keep a car, or a place where cars are repaired
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於停車、住宅和汽車維修情境，例如 parking garage（停車場大樓）、take a car to the garage（把車送去修）。重音在第二音節。

example.en: The hotel has two garages for guests and staff.
example.zh: 這間飯店有兩個車庫，分別給客人和員工使用。

example.en: The parking garage closes at midnight on weekdays.
example.zh: 停車場大樓平日午夜關閉。

example.en: Our neighbors are holding a garage sale this Saturday.
example.zh: 我們的鄰居這週六要辦車庫二手拍賣。

example.en: The company vans are kept in the garage overnight.
example.zh: 公司的廂型車晚上都停在車庫裡。

examples.en: Employees can park their cars in the underground garage.
examples.zh: 員工可以把車停在地下停車場。

examples.en: I took my car to the garage for an oil change.
examples.zh: 我把車開去修車廠換機油。

examples.en: The house has a two-car garage and a small garden.
examples.zh: 這間房子有可停兩輛車的車庫和一座小花園。

similar.diff: parking lot 是露天停車場；garage 是有屋頂的建築物或車庫。

example.en: Please leave your car in the parking lot behind the building.
example.zh: 請把車停在大樓後面的停車場。

example.en: The mechanic will check the brakes this afternoon.
example.zh: 技師今天下午會檢查煞車。

example.en: The company will repair the van free of charge.
example.zh: 公司會免費修理這輛廂型車。

example.en: Free parking is available for all hotel guests.
example.zh: 所有飯店房客都可以免費停車。

senses.en: a room or building next to a house where you keep a car

example.en: He keeps the company samples in the garage at home.
example.zh: 他把公司的樣品放在家裡的車庫裡。

senses.en: a building where many people can park their cars
senses.distinguish: 出現 parking、level、fee 時，指停車場大樓。

example.en: The garage charges five dollars for each hour after noon.
example.zh: 這個停車場中午過後每小時收費五美元。

senses.en: a place where cars are repaired
senses.distinguish: 出現 repair、mechanic、oil change 時，指修車廠。

example.en: The garage on Main Street repairs delivery trucks quickly.
example.zh: 大街上的修車廠修理貨車很快。

extra_vocab.en: things that you throw away, such as old food and paper
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室清潔、餐廳、社區環保和垃圾收集的情境。美式英文常用，英式英文多說 rubbish。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: garbage 是不可數名詞，不加 s：a lot of garbage、some garbage；要數量時說 a bag of garbage。

example.en: Please put the paper cups in the garbage can.
example.zh: 請把紙杯丟進垃圾桶。

example.en: Garbage collection in this area happens every Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 這個地區每週二早上收垃圾。

example.en: Who will take out the garbage after the office party?
example.zh: 辦公室派對結束後，誰要去倒垃圾？

examples.en: The cleaners empty all the garbage bins every evening.
examples.zh: 清潔人員每天傍晚清空所有垃圾桶。

examples.en: The restaurant produces a lot of garbage on weekends.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳週末會產生大量垃圾。

examples.en: Residents must separate garbage before putting it outside.
examples.zh: 居民必須先把垃圾分類再拿到外面。

confusable.diff: 兩個字開頭很像，但 garage 是車庫，garbage 是垃圾。

example.en: He parked the car in the garage, not on the street.
example.zh: 他把車停在車庫裡，而不是路邊。

similar.diff: trash 是美式口語，意思和 garbage 很接近；garbage 較常指廚餘和濕垃圾。

example.en: Please put your trash in the bin before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前，請把你的垃圾丟進垃圾桶。

similar.diff: rubbish 是英式說法，美國人多用 garbage 或 trash。

example.en: The office rubbish is collected every Monday morning.
example.zh: 辦公室的垃圾每週一早上會被收走。

example.en: The plant reduced its waste by twenty percent this year.
example.zh: 這間工廠今年把廢棄物減少了百分之二十。

example.en: There is a fine for leaving litter in the park.
example.zh: 在公園亂丟垃圾會被罰款。

example.en: Our office tries to recycle paper and plastic bottles.
example.zh: 我們辦公室努力回收紙張和塑膠瓶。

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to take care of a garden
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店、公園、公司庭院和社區的維護情境，常出現在園區管理或招聘的內容。

example.en: We hired two gardeners to take care of the hotel grounds.
example.zh: 我們請了兩位園丁來照顧飯店的園區。

example.en: The hotel decided to hire a gardener for the new park.
example.zh: 飯店決定為新公園請一位園丁。

example.en: A professional gardener trimmed the trees along the entrance.
example.zh: 一位專業園丁修剪了入口旁的樹木。

example.en: The head gardener plans the flower beds each spring.
example.zh: 園藝主管每年春天規劃花壇。

examples.en: The gardener waters the plants at the hotel every morning.
examples.zh: 園丁每天早上替飯店的植物澆水。

examples.en: Our company uses a gardener to keep the office grounds neat.
examples.zh: 我們公司請園丁來維持辦公園區的整潔。

examples.en: The gardener will cut the grass before the visitors arrive.
examples.zh: 園丁會在訪客抵達前把草剪好。

similar.diff: landscaper 是景觀設計或施工的人，工作規模較大；gardener 主要是日常照顧花草樹木。

example.en: A landscaper designed the new garden in front of the hotel.
example.zh: 一位景觀設計師設計了飯店前面的新花園。

example.en: The lawn in front of the office needs water.
example.zh: 辦公室前面的草坪需要澆水。

example.en: Please put the plant near the window in my office.
example.zh: 請把這盆植物放在靠窗的地方。

example.en: The hotel puts fresh flowers in every room.
example.zh: 這間飯店每個房間都放了鮮花。

derived.link: 詞幹 garden；加 -er 就是照顧花園的人，像 teacher、worker
garden + -ing，種花種草這件事變成名詞，像 cooking、shopping

extra_vocab.en: a broad statement that is true in many cases but not in all
extra_vocab.note: 多益中偏少見，常出現在報告、評論和閱讀文章，常指「以偏概全」的說法，通常帶有「不夠精確」的語氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: generalization 是可數名詞（a generalization、generalizations）；「提出概括性說法」用 make a generalization，不是 do。

example.en: Managers should avoid broad generalizations about different customer groups.
example.zh: 經理應該避免對不同客群做籠統的概括。

example.en: It is unfair to make a generalization about all workers.
example.zh: 對所有員工做籠統的概括是不公平的。

example.en: The report avoids broad generalizations and uses real sales data.
example.zh: 這份報告避免籠統的說法，而是使用實際銷售數據。

examples.en: The report is full of generalizations and has no clear data.
examples.zh: 這份報告充滿籠統的說法，沒有清楚的數據。

examples.en: That is only a generalization, so please give us numbers.
examples.zh: 那只是籠統的說法，所以請給我們數字。

examples.en: His comment was a generalization that did not fit our clients.
examples.zh: 他的評論是一種籠統的說法，並不適用我們的客戶。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音相近，但 generation 是「世代」或「產生」，不是「概括」。

example.en: The new generation of phones sells very well.
example.zh: 新一代的手機賣得很好。

example.en: Please send me a short summary of the meeting.
example.zh: 請寄給我一份會議的簡短摘要。

example.en: This plan is based on a wrong assumption.
example.zh: 這個計畫是建立在錯誤的假設上。

derived.link: 詞幹 general，意思是「一般的」，像 general manager
general + -ize，變成動詞「一般化」，像 organize、realize

extra_vocab.en: things that are made or grown to be sold
extra_vocab.note: 多益非常常見於採購、貨運、關稅和零售情境，如 consumer goods、deliver the goods、goods and services。永遠是複數形。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: goods 永遠是複數名詞，動詞用複數（The goods are ready），前面不加 a；說「一件商品」要用 an item 或 a product。

example.en: Sales of consumer goods rose sharply in the last quarter.
example.zh: 上一季消費品的銷售量大幅上升。

example.en: The supplier promised to deliver the goods by Friday morning.
example.zh: 供應商答應在週五早上交貨。

example.en: The company provides goods and services to many countries.
example.zh: 這間公司向許多國家提供商品和服務。

example.en: Please report any damaged goods within three days of delivery.
example.zh: 收到貨後三天內，請回報任何受損的貨物。

examples.en: The goods were checked carefully before they entered the warehouse.
examples.zh: 貨物在進倉庫前都經過仔細檢查。

examples.en: All goods must pass through customs before they are sold.
examples.zh: 所有貨物在銷售前都必須通過海關。

examples.en: The store sells sports goods and outdoor equipment.
examples.zh: 這間店販售運動用品和戶外裝備。

examples.en: Your goods will be shipped as soon as payment arrives.
examples.zh: 款項一到，您的貨物就會寄出。

confusable.diff: good 是形容詞「好的」；goods 是名詞「商品」，加了 s 意思完全不同。

example.en: We received a good offer from the supplier today.
example.zh: 我們今天收到供應商的一個好報價。

similar.diff: merchandise 是不可數名詞，常指零售店裡賣的商品；goods 用法較廣，也常用在運輸和貿易。

example.en: The store gets new merchandise from its suppliers every week.
example.zh: 這間店每週都會進新的商品。

similar.diff: products 是可數名詞，強調公司製造或販售的產品；goods 則泛指貨物。

example.en: Our products are sold in more than ten countries.
example.zh: 我們的產品在十多個國家販售。

example.en: Freight costs have gone up since last year.
example.zh: 運費從去年開始上漲。

example.en: The cargo will arrive at the port on Friday.
example.zh: 這批貨物週五會抵達港口。

example.en: Your shipment left the warehouse early this morning by truck.
example.zh: 您的貨品今天早上已離開倉庫。

extra_vocab.en: something you wear on your hands to keep them warm or safe
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於工廠安全規定、餐飲衛生和醫療情境，常用複數 gloves，也常說 a pair of gloves。

example.en: Workers must wear gloves when they handle the chemicals.
example.zh: 員工處理化學藥品時必須戴手套。

example.en: I bought a pair of gloves for the winter trip.
example.zh: 我為冬天的旅行買了一雙手套。

example.en: The store sells work gloves at a low price.
example.zh: 這間店以低價販售工作手套。

example.en: Cleaners should put on rubber gloves before using the liquid.
example.zh: 清潔人員使用這種清潔液前，應先戴上橡膠手套。

examples.en: Safety gloves are provided for all staff on the production line.
examples.zh: 生產線上的所有員工都有提供安全手套。

examples.en: The cook changed his gloves before preparing the next dish.
examples.zh: 廚師在準備下一道菜前先換了手套。

examples.en: Nurses throw away their gloves after each patient visit.
examples.zh: 護理師每次看完一位病人就丟掉手套。

confusable.diff: 拼法少一個 g，發音押韻；love 是「喜愛」，glove 是手套。

example.en: Customers love the new design of our product.
example.zh: 顧客很喜歡我們產品的新設計。

confusable.diff: 拼法接近，但 globe 是「地球、地球儀」，發音是 /ɡloʊb/。

example.en: Our company has offices all over the globe.
example.zh: 我們公司在全世界都有辦公室。

example.en: Visitors must wear a mask inside the laboratory.
example.zh: 訪客進入實驗室必須戴口罩。

example.en: Everyone on the building site must wear a helmet.
example.zh: 工地上的每個人都必須戴安全帽。

example.en: Staff must wear a clean uniform every day.
example.zh: 員工每天都必須穿乾淨的制服。

extra_vocab.en: a metal frame for cooking food over heat
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、菜單和公司烤肉活動的情境。動詞可以指「燒烤」，也可以指「嚴格盤問」，語氣很強。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「盤問」的用法是 grill someone about + 事情，常用被動：be grilled about。

example.en: The store sells gas grills and other outdoor products.
example.zh: 這間店販售瓦斯烤爐和其他戶外用品。

example.en: The chef grills each steak for exactly six minutes.
example.zh: 主廚把每塊牛排剛好烤六分鐘。

example.en: She grilled the vegetables before adding them to the salad.
example.zh: 她先把蔬菜烤過，再加進沙拉裡。

example.en: The menu includes grilled fish with rice and soup.
example.zh: 菜單上有烤魚搭配飯和湯。

example.en: Grilling meat outdoors is not allowed in this park.
example.zh: 這座公園不准在戶外烤肉。

example.en: The hotel garden has a charcoal grill for guests.
example.zh: 飯店花園裡有一個供客人使用的炭火烤架。

example.en: They opened a bar and grill near the station.
example.zh: 他們在車站附近開了一間酒吧燒烤餐廳。

example.en: Reporters grilled the CEO about the sudden price rise.
example.zh: 記者針對突然的漲價嚴格盤問執行長。

examples.en: The restaurant has a large grill in the open kitchen.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳的開放式廚房裡有一個大烤架。

examples.en: We grill fresh fish and vegetables every evening.
examples.zh: 我們每天傍晚都烤新鮮的魚和蔬菜。

examples.en: Our team will grill burgers at the company picnic.
examples.zh: 我們團隊會在公司野餐時烤漢堡。

examples.en: The panel grilled him about his sales record for an hour.
examples.zh: 面試小組針對他的銷售紀錄盤問了一個小時。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音相近；drill 是「鑽孔機、演習」，不是烤架。

example.en: The company holds a fire drill every six months.
example.zh: 公司每六個月會舉行一次消防演習。

similar.diff: roast 通常是用烤箱烘烤整塊肉或蔬菜；grill 是直接在火或加熱面上烤。

example.en: We roast the chicken in the oven for an hour.
example.zh: 我們把雞肉放進烤箱烤一個小時。

similar.diff: barbecue 是戶外烤肉或烤肉聚會，強調活動；grill 強調烤的動作或烤具。

example.en: The firm held a barbecue for all staff on Friday.
example.zh: 公司週五為全體員工舉辦了烤肉活動。

example.en: The head chef creates a new menu every season.
example.zh: 主廚每一季都會設計新菜單。

example.en: The lunch menu at our staff cafeteria changes every Monday.
example.zh: 午餐菜單每週一更換。

example.en: The kitchen opens at six for breakfast service.
example.zh: 廚房六點開始供應早餐。

example.en: Please clean the grill after each night of service.
example.zh: 每晚營業結束後，請清潔烤架。

example.en: They grill steaks and seafood on the terrace.
example.zh: 他們在露台上烤牛排和海鮮。

senses.en: a metal tool or machine for cooking food over heat

example.en: Turn off the grill before you leave the kitchen.
example.zh: 離開廚房前，請先關掉烤爐。

senses.en: a restaurant that serves food cooked on a grill
senses.distinguish: 常出現在店名，如 Harbor Grill。

example.en: We booked a table at the Harbor Grill for six.
example.zh: 我們在 Harbor Grill 訂了六人桌。

senses.en: to cook food over or under strong heat

example.en: Grill the chicken for ten minutes on each side.
example.zh: 雞肉每一面烤十分鐘。

senses.en: to ask someone many hard questions
senses.distinguish: 後面接 about 加事情，且受詞是人時，指盤問。

example.en: The managers grilled the new team about the missed deadline.
example.zh: 經理們就錯過截止日的事嚴格盤問新團隊。
